messages.author: 576882d2aaeea60e
messages.subject: pkde() error
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to run pkde() for a few sea turtle tracks but I receive the following error:


> PKDE_wun <- pkde(wun.trj, UDS_wun)
* Model selection for location-mean μ distribution.
ΔAICc
anisotropic-μ 0.000000e+00
isotropic-μ   2.938771e+01
Dirac-δ       1.536822e+06
* Model selection for location-covariance σ distribution.
ΔAICc
anisotropic-σ diag(Σ)    0.00000
anisotropic-σ           77.61512
isotropic-σ           1272.25259
isotropic-σ diag(Σ)   1287.79433
anisotropic-σ Dirac-δ 2693.08774
isotropic-σ Dirac-δ   3303.82177
Error in cbind(M2) - outer(M1) : non-conformable arrays


I ran akde() [UDS-wun] a few months ago and now used the object to run pkde(). Do I maybe have to re-run my akde's to make pkde work? I thought I'll as before doing so as this will take days even in parallel.... 

files attached...

Cheers

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: pkde() error
parts:
Hi Ingo,

Unfortunately, I had to update the structure of the UD objects from akde() to have the appropriate bias correction in pkde().
pkde() is new functionality that is not yet published.

Best,
Chris
